samples.question: The picture shows two colour rules and a START disc. The ACTUAL RULE legend pairs every source colour with the target colour it turns into under that rule; the colour the ACTUAL RULE would give for the START disc is shown in the NOW disc. The IF RULE is a copy of the ACTUAL RULE in which exactly one entry is changed: the row for the START colour now points at a different target colour. This is a counterfactual: suppose the IF RULE, not the ACTUAL RULE, had produced the outcome for the same START colour. Which colour would the IF RULE have given for the START disc? Answer red, blue, green, or orange.
